notes:
Product summary: SynapsePad builds a VS Code-focused AI pair-programmer — lightweight extension that streams token-by-token into inline suggestions. Primary requirement: sub-100ms token-to-editor latency and deterministic completion ordering when suggestions are updated mid-stream.

From engineering: 'Streaming needs to feel native — can't wait for full chunk generation.' Wants model/version pinning per extension release (stable model locked to extension v2.1). Also wants per-seat and per-repo rate limits (tiered) plus token budget alerts.

Security: enterprise customers require SSO (SAML), audit logs, and ability to route some traffic through customer VPC (for dedicated customers). Retention controls: 7-day dev logs, 90-day enterprise logs depending on tier.

POC notes: running dedicated small GPU pool (4xA10g analog) for perf baseline. Early numbers: median first-token latency 45ms in us-west region, 95th pctk ~210ms during 8-concurrent-editor sessions. Need to validate under 50 concurrent sessions.

Commercial: initial ask: price per monthly seats + committed tokens for code-completion. Echoed competitor pricing (Copilot) as benchmark; high sensitivity to per-seat price above $7/user/mo.

Sales touches: keep messaging on SDKs for streaming + client-side rate-limit hooks. SE to deliver integration notes and fallback patterns (non-streaming degrade) in next drive doc.

Quote from Eng Lead (R. Patel): 'If we can guarantee consistent streaming under 100ms and clean fallback to non-streaming with same suggestions, this is a must-buy.'
